name: dart-store-release
title: Dart store release readiness audit
description: Audit both terminal surfaces and local toolchain, hide network features for the Dart offline product, verify all 120 lessons and examples, build and test Android and OHOS with workspace-isolated Pi collaboration and conventional commits.
creator: lichengyu
notes: Release source audit complete: 120 lessons/120 examples real, Dart103/core479 tests green, Android SDK+terminal16 device checks passed. Final Android ARM64 APK153.0MiB and OHOS unsigned HAP39.8MiB built against core 8b33443 snapshot. Final APK reinstallation queued behind Web/Python/SQL; no more Android foreground/install operations. OHOS device rejects unsigned HAP9568320; own legacy DartWing profile recovered but matching configured private keystore is missing. Keep in_progress for signed OHOS execution and final reduced-APK device confirmation. Android store signing also remains required. Exact evidence: research/platform-verification.md.
